Next acceptance: Define protocol/security/native permissions, implement and test on authorized devices; do not claim code from a README badge.

Next acceptance: Verify exact polling paths on Windows/macOS before changing them; retain bounded waits and error diagnostics.

## IDENTICAL_REINSERT — needs_verification

A SIM unplug/reinsert with identical observed USB/ICCID/owner between samples cannot be certified by ordinary snapshot tests.

Next acceptance: Native event/generation evidence and narrowly timed real HIL on all supported platforms; report uncertainty when indistinguishable.

## INCIDENT_MM_CLOSE — unresolved_cause

Historical forced-close root cause remains unknown. Current Linux ModemManager access is private D-Bus, not an mmcli subprocess whose stderr can simply be recovered.

Next acceptance: Collect bounded redacted evidence at the real current transport boundary when authorized; do not invent carrier/port causes from generic symptoms.
